tickets.title: Support requests
tickets.intro: Every request your customers raised, newest first.
tickets.subject: Subject

detail.noMessages: Nothing has been written on this request yet.
detail.internalToggle: Keep this as an internal note
detail.internalHint: Your customer never sees an internal note, and the status of the request stays as it is.
detail.escalateMessage: The request "{{subject}}" goes to the support team of the platform operator and is set back to open. Your customer is not told about it.
detail.escalateDone: Request handed over to platform support
detail.escalatedHint: This request sits with platform support.

customers.title: Customers
customers.hint: Accounts with the service and the portal logins that belong to them.
customers.noLoginHint: This customer cannot sign in to this portal yet.
customers.empty: No customers yet. Add the first one.
customers.suspendMessage: Suspend {{email}}? The portal and the service are blocked right away.
customers.deleteMessage: Delete the customer {{email}} for good? The account and the portal login go together.

dialog.createIntro: The account with the service and the portal login are created together.
dialog.sendInvite: Send the invitation by e-mail right away

balance.title: Balance
balance.hint: The prepaid wallet of the customer, in euros.
balance.insufficient: The wallet does not hold that much. Available: {{balance}}.

usage.title: Usage
usage.empty: Nothing was used in this period.

billing.title: Billing details
billing.hint: Where the customer's invoices go and what they say.
billing.noEmail: Without a billing email, invoices cannot be sent by email.
billing.emailHint: Invoices go to this address only.
billing.dialogIntro: These details appear on the customer's invoices. An emptied field is removed.

errors.invalid_postal_code: The postal code does not match the country.
errors.invalid_vat_id: The VAT ID is not in a valid format.
errors.invalid_billing_email: This billing email is not valid.
errors.invalid_billing_cc_email: The copy address is not valid.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: Plans are what your customers subscribe to. Type, billing cycle and allowances are fixed once a plan exists.
plans.empty: No plan has been created yet.
plans.deleteMessage: The plan "{{name}}" will be deleted. Existing subscriptions prevent that.

dialog.editIntro: Type, billing cycle and allowances of an existing plan can no longer be changed.
dialog.allowanceHint: Leave empty for use without a limit, zero for nothing included.
dialog.addonHint: On an add-on package the allowance is also the size of the package.

pricing.title: Prices
pricing.intro: These two prices apply to what your customers use. Your margin is the difference.
pricing.suggestionsIntro: A suggestion only fills the fields. Nothing is stored until you save.

numbers.title: Phone numbers
numbers.intro: One markup in percent on the setup fee and monthly price of platform numbers. Your balance is charged the platform price, the difference is yours.
numbers.label: Markup
numbers.invalid: Please enter a markup between 0 and 500 %.
numbers.example: Example: a number at {{base}} per month costs your customers {{price}} net.
numbers.platformBilled: The markup applies once you have added your own payment details. Until then your customers buy numbers at the platform price.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.intro: Every subscription ties one customer to one plan and a term.
subscriptions.cancelMessage: The subscription of {{customer}} runs for another 30 days and ends then.
subscriptions.cancelImmediateMessage: The subscription of {{customer}} ends at once. Nothing is refunded and there is no way back.

dialog.title: New subscription
dialog.intro: The subscription starts at once and ends after the chosen term.
dialog.customerHint: Only customers that already exist can hold a subscription.

addons.title: Add-on packages
addons.intro: Extra minutes and conversations a customer buys on top of a plan.

packages.title: Packages on offer
packages.intro: Each package is an add-on plan that is active and visible.
packages.empty: No package is on offer yet. Add a plan of type add-on package under Plans.

purchases.title: Sales
purchases.empty: No package has been sold yet.

dialog.title: Sell a package
dialog.intro: The credits reach the customer straight away and lapse after twelve months.

payments.balance: Take it from the customer balance

dialog.paymentHint: With the second choice no money moves and collecting it is up to you.
dialog.noPackages: There is no package on offer that could be sold.
dialog.balanceTooLow: The balance of this customer is not high enough for this.
dialog.noSubscription: This customer has no running subscription a package could add to.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: Invoices you raise against your customers. Sending and collecting stay with you.
invoices.empty: No invoice has been created yet.
invoices.markPaidMessage: Invoice {{number}} is recorded as paid and stamped with today's date. No money is moved by this.

detail.noItems: This invoice has no line items.

dialog.title: Create an invoice
dialog.intro: The invoice is created as a draft. Nothing is sent and no payment is collected; the number is assigned by the system.

mail.title: Email invoice {{number}}
mail.loadError: The preview could not be loaded.

problem.customer_gone: The customer was deleted. The invoice can no longer be emailed.
problem.no_billing_email: No billing email is on file for this customer.
problem.company_incomplete: Your company details are incomplete. Add under Settings: {{fields}}.
problem.no_smtp: No mail server is set up for sending.
problem.daily_limit: {{limit}} invoices have already been emailed today. Sending resumes tomorrow.

mail.fallbackLang: There is no template in this language. The English text is used.
mail.subject: Subject
mail.templateHint: Suggested by your invoice template. Logo, company details and the PDF are added automatically.
mail.portalLink: Add a link to the customer portal

numbers.title: Phone numbers
numbers.intro: The phone numbers of your portal. Buy platform numbers or bring your own, hand a free number to a customer, or take an assigned one back.
numbers.label: Label
numbers.empty: There is no free number in the pool.
numbers.emptyAssigned: No number is assigned at the moment.
numbers.releaseMessage: Number {{number}} is taken from the customer and returns to the pool. Calls to it no longer reach them afterwards.
numbers.released: The number is back in the pool.
numbers.deleteMessage: Number {{number}} is removed from the pool for good, together with the trunk credentials stored with it. The contract with the carrier it came from is not affected.

assignDialog.title: Assign the number
assignDialog.intro: Number {{number}} goes to this customer. They can then point one of their agents at it.
assignDialog.freeHint: The customer pays nothing for the number. A bought platform number keeps costing you the platform price.
assignDialog.chargeHint: The customer pays your price for the number from their balance, the first month now and every month after. The invoice is issued to them in your name.
assignDialog.chargeNeedsPayment: Add your own payment details first, then your customers can pay for numbers.

importDialog.title: Import a number of your own
importDialog.intro: Bring over a number you already hold with your carrier. The credentials are passed on and never read back.
importDialog.label: Label

sip.title: SIP trunk
sip.addressHint: Host or IP of your trunk, for example sip.example.com
sip.allowedAddressesHint: Separate several with a comma. Leave empty when your carrier does not ask for it.

carrier.title: Account with the carrier
carrier.optional: Optional. Without them the account token is used.

importDialog.secretHint: Credentials are only passed on to telephony and are not shown again afterwards.

numbers.stopSaleMessage: Your customers can no longer buy {{number}}. It stays in the pool and can be offered again at any time.

saleDialog.title: Offer number
saleDialog.intro: Your customers can buy {{number}} themselves at this monthly price. They pay from their balance.
saleDialog.priceHint: At most €1,000. VAT is added at purchase.
saleDialog.invalid: Please enter a monthly price above 0 and at most €1,000.

numbers.offerBoughtMessage: Your customers can buy number {{number}} themselves. They pay the platform price plus your markup from their balance.
numbers.returnMessage: Number {{number}} goes back to the platform and stops costing your balance from now on. The month already paid is not refunded, and the number may go to others afterwards.
numbers.returned: Number {{number}} went back to the platform.
numbers.bought: Number {{number}} is now part of your stock.
numbers.assignedCharged: Number {{number}} was assigned. The customer pays {{price}} a month, net, from their balance.

chargeErrors.insufficient_balance: The customer’s balance does not cover the first month.
chargeErrors.billing_profile_incomplete: The customer’s billing details are incomplete, so no invoice can be issued to them.

buyDialog.title: Buy a platform number
buyDialog.intro: The number then belongs to your stock. Your balance pays the first month at once and then every month on the same day until you give the number back. You receive an invoice for every month.
buyDialog.empty: No platform numbers are available right now.
buyDialog.summary: {{gross}} is debited from your balance today, including {{vat}}% VAT. After that you pay this amount for {{number}} every month until you give the number back.

users.title: Users
users.empty: No users yet. Invite the first person.
users.linkMessage: No mail server is configured. Pass this link on in person. It is valid for a limited time only.
users.clearTwoFactorMessage: Remove the second factor of {{email}}? Until they set up a new one, the link from their mailbox is all it takes.

dialog.inviteIntro: The person receives a link that activates their account.
dialog.customerHint: Customer number from your partner account with the service. Without it the person sees no usage data.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: What your customers used and what it earned.
analytics.noUsage: Nothing was used in this period.
analytics.billedNote: The figures come from billed usage, not from open invoices.
analytics.otherPeriod: Pick a longer period to see more.

agents.title: Customer agents
agents.intro: Every voice agent and chatbot in the portal, with its owner.
agents.name: Name
agents.openHint: Opens the portal in this customer's view.
agents.emptyAgents: No voice agent has been created yet.
agents.emptyChatbots: No chatbot has been created yet.

branding.intro: Name, logo and colour appear throughout the portal and in the e-mails.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG. Large pictures are shrunk for you while they upload.

logo.type: Please choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image.
logo.tooLarge: This picture cannot be made small enough. Please choose a simpler logo.
logo.unreadable: This file cannot be opened as a picture.

mail.intro: The portal sends invitations and sign-in links through this server.
mail.envSource: Configured through the server environment. Settings on this page take precedence.
mail.notConfigured: No mail server configured yet. Invitation links then have to be passed on by hand.
mail.passKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
mail.removeMessage: The stored SMTP credentials will be deleted. The server environment applies again afterwards, if anything is configured there.

registration.intro: Who may open an account here. This is off until you switch it on.
registration.selfServiceHint: A sign-up form appears on the sign-in page. Each new account also becomes a customer of yours at the service.
registration.mailRequired: This needs a mail server. Set one up under E-mail first.

hub.intro: Company data, portal logo, payment keys and mail sending of your provider account. These are kept by the service, not by the portal.
hub.companyHint: These details appear on the invoices you issue to your customers.
hub.logoHint: The logo is not uploaded. Enter the address of a file that is already reachable.
hub.paymentsHint: A stored key is never shown again. An empty field leaves the stored value untouched.
hub.invoiceDetails: Details on the invoices you issue
hub.invoiceDetailsHint: Bank details, payment term and footer appear on every invoice you issue.
hub.incomplete: No invoice can be issued while these details are missing: {{fields}}.
hub.taxExemptionPlaceholder: No VAT charged under the small business scheme.
hub.taxExemptionHint: Appears on every invoice below the amounts, for example for small businesses.

mailDefaults.title: Email templates of your customers
mailDefaults.hint: When a customer creates an email template, “Send anonymously” is already on. Name, phone number, email address and postal address are then left out of the email. Applies to new templates, existing ones keep their setting. Customers can change this for each template.
mailDefaults.savedOn: New templates of your customers now start with “Send anonymously” on.
mailDefaults.savedOff: New templates of your customers now start with “Send anonymously” off.

mailServer.title: Mail server for invoices and tickets
mailServer.hint: Your invoices and ticket emails reach your customers through this server, with your address as the sender. The credentials are kept encrypted by the service. Invitations and sign-in links of the portal still go through the server on the Email tab.

source.reseller: Your emails go through your own server {{host}}, sender {{from}}.
source.platform: Your emails go through the server of the service, sender {{from}}. With your own server, your address is the sender.
source.none: No email can reach your customers right now. Set up a mail server here.

mailServer.secure: Encrypted from the start (SSL/TLS, usually port 465)
mailServer.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
mailServer.sendTest: Send a test email to me
mailServer.testHint: The test email goes to {{email}} through the saved server.
mailServer.saveFirst: Save your changes before you send a test email.
mailServer.saved: The mail server has been saved.
mailServer.testSent: The test email is on its way to {{email}}.

result.auth: The user name or password was refused.
result.host_not_found: The server was not found. Check the spelling.
result.host_blocked: This server is not allowed. Use a mail server that is reachable publicly.
result.refused: The server refused the connection. Check server and port.
result.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Check server and port.
result.tls: The encryption does not match the port. Switch “Encrypted from the start” or check the port.
result.certificate: The certificate of the server is invalid or has expired.
result.sender_rejected: The server refused the sender address.
result.recipient_rejected: The server refused the recipient address.
result.not_configured: No mail server of your own is active. Save one and switch it on.
result.unknown: The test email could not be sent. Check the details.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: All changes made by administrators and security-relevant events.

hub.intro: What the service recorded about your provider account: customers created, pricing changes, credentials updated.
hub.empty: The service has not recorded anything yet.

serviceOrders.title: Service order
serviceOrders.askHint: Write your question below as a reply in the ticket. The customer gets an email and confirms once they have answered.
serviceOrders.cancelDesc: The order ends and the ticket is closed. This cannot be undone.
serviceOrders.forwardHint: The platform's team takes over the work. Your balance is charged {{gross}} ({{net}} net). Your customer keeps talking only to you.
serviceOrders.forwardShort: Your balance is not enough: {{balance}} available, {{gross}} needed. Top up your balance first.
serviceOrders.forwardConfirmDesc: Your balance is charged {{gross}} ({{net}} net) now, and a ticket is opened with the platform's team. You can follow the progress here in the ticket.
serviceOrders.forwardDone: Forwarded as ticket #{{ticket}}, {{amount}} charged to your balance

forwardErrors.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Your balance is not enough. Top up your balance and try again.
forwardErrors.ALREADY_FORWARDED: This order has already been forwarded.
forwardErrors.NOT_AVAILABLE: The platform does not offer this service right now, so it cannot be forwarded.

serviceOrders.ownHint: This is your own service. You do the work yourself, it cannot be forwarded to the platform.

services.title: Services
services.intro: What your customers can order in their account under Services. Every order reaches you as a ticket, where you do the work.
services.loadError: The services could not be loaded.

offers.title: Platform services
offers.intro: All prices are net. Your customers also pay {{vat}} % VAT from their balance. Without a price of your own they pay your purchase price.
offers.empty: The platform offers no services right now.
offers.offHint: Your customers do not see this service.

errors.PRICE_BELOW_COST: A price is below your purchase price.
errors.PRICE_INVALID: Enter a price in euros, for example 79.00.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This service no longer exists. The list was reloaded.

own.title: Your own services
own.intro: Services you offer and do yourself. You set the price, the variants and what the customer tells you when ordering.
own.empty: You have no services of your own yet.
own.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" disappears for your customers. Existing orders keep their ticket. This cannot be undone.
own.descriptionHint: Your customers read this before ordering. {price} is replaced with the price.
own.variantHint: With variants each one has its own price, and the customer picks one.
own.fieldsHint: The answers appear in the order's ticket.
own.visibleHint: Hidden services stay saved, but your customers cannot order them.

errors.PRICE_INVALID: Enter a price in euros up to 100,000, for example 79.00.
errors.SLA_INVALID: The shortest turnaround cannot be longer than the longest.
errors.POSITION_LIMIT: You have reached the maximum number of your own services. Delete one first.
